name: Dundalk CT MiniPOD 4-Person Outdoor Sauna
description: Dundalk CT Canadian Timber MiniPOD | CTC77MW The Dundalk LeisureCraft MiniPOD sauna, also called a raindrop, is almost a cross between the barrel sauna and the cabin sauna. Unique in its look and practical if you are in a location that gets a lot of snow. It will slide right off the roof. This handcrafted Canadian sauna measures 7' x 7', is made of 1.5" thick Eastern White Cedar lumber, and features a large tempered glass window on the door for visibility while maintaining privacy. Black asphalt shingles protect the outside walls. With 2 long benches that run the length of the side walls, it can comfortably seat up to 4 people sitting up or 2 people laying down. The sauna is an easy-to-assemble kit, and you can choose between a wood-burning or electric sauna heater. The CT MiniPOD Sauna is a 7x7 (184cm) Sauna with side wall benches to seat up to 4 people sitting up or 2 people laying down. This model is also handcrafted in Canada with Eastern White Cedar lumber that is 1.5" (35mm) thick and select tight knot grade. The door features a large tempered glass window and the outside walls are protected with black asphalt shingles. This easy to assembly kit is available with wood burning or electric sauna heater. Features 100% Canadian Made - Crafted in Canada using locally sourced premium cedar and expert Canadian craftsmanship. Solid Single Stave Wood Bevels - Premium Grade-A solid cedar construction for exceptional strength and durability. Wood Resistant to Rot, Decay, and Insects - Naturally durable Canadian cedar built to withstand the outdoor elements. Triple-Layer Roof System - Cedar planks, ice and water shield, and black Cambridge asphalt shingles provide lasting weather protection and insulation. Personalized for You - Available with customizable options to suit your preferred sauna experience. Environmentally Friendly - Responsibly sourced cedar from certified sustainable Canadian lumber mills.
